[package]
name = "mdbx-core"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
sha2 = "0.10"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4", "serde"]

[package]
name = "mdbx-crypto"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
sha2 = "0.10"
hmac = "0.12"
argon2 = "0.5"
chacha20poly1305 = "0.10"
hkdf = "0.12"
rand = "0.8"
zeroize = "1.8"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[package]
name = "mdbx-storage"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[features]
default = ["kdbx-import", "kdbx-export", "kdbx-binary-import", "kdbx-binary-export", "benchmarks", "derived-search-index", "filesystem-blob-store"]
core = []
filesystem-blob-store = []
kdbx-import = []
kdbx-export = []
kdbx-binary-import = ["kdbx-import", "dep:keepass"]
kdbx-binary-export = ["kdbx-export", "dep:keepass", "dep:keepass-argon2", "keepass/save_kdbx4"]
derived-search-index = []
benchmarks = ["derived-search-index"]

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "0.10"
thiserror = "2"
unicode-normalization = "0.1"
zeroize = "1.8"
base64 = "0.22"
tempfile = "3"

[dependencies.mdbx-core]
path = "../mdbx-core"

[dependencies.mdbx-crypto]
path = "../mdbx-crypto"

[dependencies.mdbx-sync]
path = "../mdbx-sync"
default-features = false

[dependencies.rusqlite]
version = "0.31"
features = ["backup", "bundled"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4", "serde"]

[dependencies.keepass]
version = "0.13.17"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.keepass-argon2]
package = "rust-argon2"
version = "3.0"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]

[package]
name = "mdbx-sync"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[features]
default = []
zstd-compression = ["dep:zstd"]

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
sha2 = "0.10"
hmac = "0.12"

[dependencies.mdbx-core]
path = "../mdbx-core"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.bincode]
version = "2"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.zstd]
version = "0.13"
optional = true
default-features = false
